prompt: @first_frame A red curly toy poodle in a white towel turban and black cat-eye sunglasses lies relaxed in a pink-tiled bathtub, holding an open orange leather book whose cover reads «ЛАПАКЮР». A very slow, calm, luxurious spa moment. The camera is completely static: a locked-off tripod shot with no zoom, no pan, no tilt and no camera shake; the tiles, the tiled ledge, the tub, the towel and the brass taps never move. Action, all of it slow and unhurried: the poodle gently turns a page of the book as in @keyframe_1 and settles back; then it slowly lifts the stemmed glass of rosé wine from the tiled ledge with its free front paw and takes a small sip as in @keyframe_2; then it slowly sets the glass back in the same place on the ledge and returns to the same relaxed pose, ending exactly as @last_frame. Gentle breathing, a slight head movement, the water surface barely moving. The book cover stays facing the camera and the title «ЛАПАКЮР» stays readable throughout. Soft window light, fine film grain, hyperreal vintage editorial photography. The poodle always has exactly two front paws. No other text, no logos, no people.
